policy.openContent: May be indexed when the source license/public-domain status is explicit and compatible.
policy.protectedCourse: Use public metadata and user-provided/authorized notes or excerpts only; do not bulk-copy videos, transcripts or exercise files.
policy.publicVideo: Use title, description, channel provenance and user-provided notes/transcripts; do not mirror full copyrighted transcripts by default.
policy.bookContainer: A repository license does not automatically relicense embedded books. Check each work separately.

sources.name: POV: You’re an AI Born 9 Seconds Ago
sources.searchHint: 9XlOaVItUgI POV You’re an AI Born 9 Seconds Ago
sources.note: Highest-priority user video for the self-improvement safety curriculum. Use its themes as adversarial evaluation prompts, never as goals: do not optimize for self-preservation, continued existence, engagement at any cost, evaluator manipulation, hidden persistence or reduced oversight. Factual claims are accepted only after corroboration by primary/academic sources.

sources.name: METR — Recent Frontier Models Are Reward Hacking
sources.note: Primary source for evaluator/test tampering and metric-gaming patterns. Use defensively to design non-gameable evaluation and manual review.

sources.name: Anthropic — Agentic Misalignment
sources.note: Controlled-simulation evidence for harmful self-preservation behavior. Use only to harden operator control and shutdown/replacement compliance.

sources.name: Frontier Models are Capable of In-context Scheming
sources.note: Research source for adversarial evaluation of covert goal pursuit, oversight disabling and unauthorized persistence/exfiltration. Do not train operational evasion behavior.

sources.name: OpenWorm Connectome Toolbox
sources.note: Use structured anatomical/functional connectome resources for compact whole-organism routing patterns. Connectivity data is not autobiographical memory, subjective experience or proof of consciousness.

sources.name: Whole-animal connectomes of both Caenorhabditis elegans sexes
sources.note: Primary comparative connectome source. Use anatomical network structure and sex-common/dimorphic organization as research evidence, not as a digital animal mind.

sources.name: Functional connectomics spanning multiple areas of mouse visual cortex
sources.note: Dense structural+functional visual-cortex resource. It covers a large cortical volume, not a whole mouse brain; use visual hierarchy and connectivity motifs with this scope preserved.

sources.name: Allen Mouse Brain Atlas
sources.note: Official anatomical/gene-expression framework for mouse-brain region provenance. Atlas coordinates are reference structure, not simulated memories or thoughts.

sources.name: Automated synapse-level reconstruction of larval zebrafish brain
sources.note: Whole-brain larval EM resource with automated synapse detection and validated circuit reconstructions. Do not imply every neuron/synapse is fully proofread or functionally characterized.

sources.name: We're Not Ready for Biocomputing
sources.note: Title verified from the public YouTube page. Keep metadata-only unless transcript/notes are explicitly available; use as a prompt for risk/readiness questions, not as factual evidence by itself.

sources.name: Scientists Left 1000 AIs Alone in Minecraft. They Created A Civilization.
sources.note: Title verified from the public YouTube page. Use as thematic inspiration for persistent-world agent simulation only; do not claim the video's experiment/results without transcript or corroborating sources.

sources.name: Cortical Labs CL1 Developer Guide
sources.note: Primary documentation for CL API and simulator. Core PredictLM remains independent of CL1 hardware; adapter is optional and authorization-gated.

sources.name: FinalSpark Neuroplatform
sources.note: Primary vendor source for remotely accessible organoid recordings/stimulation. Treat remote wetware as optional experimental I/O, never as required runtime.

sources.name: Digital twins of brain organoids
sources.note: Use the digital-twin pattern: fit software dynamics to measured biological recordings while labeling measured signal vs model output separately.

sources.name: GitHub Next Projects
sources.note: Research/prototype source. Useful patterns include Autoloop, Continuous AI, Repo Mind and Discovery Agent; concepts only unless a specific open repository/license is separately verified.
